tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find current or planned Hungarian EU funding opportunities, grant topics, eligibility guidance or EU Money knowledge articles. Call search before fetch when you do not already have an EU Money entity ID.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this after search to retrieve one complete, citation-ready EU Money grant, draft, topic or knowledge record by ID. It returns structured source facts plus clearly identified explanatory guidance.

tools.name: render_results
tools.description: Use this when one or more EU Money IDs have already been selected and the user wants compact interactive cards. It does not search, submit an application or change any data.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
